# Two draft agreements, article by article (generated by `closure treaty coverage --write`; do not edit by hand)

Sources: [MA] Scher, Abecassis, Barnett and Abeyta, *An International Agreement to Prevent the Premature Creation of Artificial Superintelligence* (MIRI Technical Governance Team, arXiv:2511.10783, v3); [FLI] Future of Life Institute with the Centre for International Governance Innovation, *Draft Articles on the Safe Development and Diffusion of Artificial Intelligence* (web version 2, 18 June 2026, global-governance.ai). Status: implemented (code and tests here), hardware-gated (code here; what it checks has to be measured on hardware), partial (the note says what is missing), physical and policy (outside software).

**99 rows**: 51 for [MA], 48 for [FLI]. Software rows: 61, every one with code and a test (implemented 49, hardware-gated 8, partial 4). Physical 5, policy 33: not counted as covered.

Every article of both texts has at least one row (`tests/test_treaty_agreements.py::test_every_article_and_annex_has_a_row`). The findings the computations make are in docs/TREATY_COVERAGE.md under "What the computations show".
